resolved_findings.finding: Local draft deletion trusted an ID without rechecking owner and active persona.
resolved_findings.resolution: Delete reads the draft and denies mutation unless both owner and persona match.

resolved_findings.finding: Captured media attachment failure could leave camera and microphone tracks active.
resolved_findings.resolution: Capture and recording callbacks stop all tracks before returning the localized attachment error.

resolved_findings.finding: IndexedDB failure was rendered as a normal empty draft library.
resolved_findings.resolution: A truthful localized failure state with Retry is distinct from a valid empty result.

resolved_findings.finding: MediaRecorder construction could throw and strand the recording flow.
resolved_findings.resolution: Construction is guarded and returns the localized native-camera fallback error.

resolved_findings.finding: Create, camera and draft states were Romanian-only and draft dates ignored persona locale.
resolved_findings.resolution: RO, EN, PL and AR catalogue parity covers the bounded surface and dates use the resolved interface locale.

capacity.observed_evidence: Capacity indicator is not programmatically observable in this run; the separate worker remains usage-limited.
